# Problem 77: CNX-006 — DAQ MQTT Ingestion

**Parent:** [CellNostix Platform Overview](./83-cellnostix-platform-overview.md)

## Business Problem

Reliably **receive, validate, deduplicate, and persist** DAQ telemetry from the Windows client so web APIs and predictive eval always see consistent run and cycle data.

## Hard Requirements

- MQTT broker in compose stack (`mqtt-broker-*-nas` services).
- Server-side persistence to PostgreSQL (`cycle_data`, `cycle_step_data`, run metadata).
- API layer in `internal/acquire/daq.go` serves web UI and alertwatcher reads.
- At-least-once ingest with idempotent writes where possible.
- Synchronized data available to CNX-004 feature extraction and CNX-010 analysis views.

## Why One Pattern Is Not Enough

| If you only use… | What breaks |
| --- | --- |
| HTTP upload only from client | No streaming; large run memory pressure |
| DB write in MQTT handler thread | Blocks broker; loses messages |
| No dedupe on reconnect | Duplicate cycles / corrupt CRE |
| Client writes DB directly | Security + schema coupling |

You need **message broker**, **queue-based load leveling**, **idempotent persistence**, and **repository APIs**.

## Architecture Overview

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Client["DAQ_App"]
    Broker["MQTT broker"]
    Ingest["daq.go ingest + validate"]
    PG["PostgreSQL"]
    Web["CNX-003 web UI"]
    Eval["CNX-004 alertwatcher"]

    Client --> Broker --> Ingest --> PG
    PG --> Web
    PG --> Eval
```

## Pattern Mix

| Concern | Patterns | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transport | [Pub/Sub](../Messaging_Integration_patterns/) | MQTT topics |
| Buffering | [Queue-Based Load Leveling](../Scalability_patterns/09-queue-based-load-leveling.md) | Burst telemetry |
| Writes | [Idempotency](../Distributed_system_patterns/20-idempotency.md) | Reconnect safety |
| Storage | [Repository](../Data_domain_patterns/01-repository.md) | Run / cycle tables |
| Time series | [Time-Series](../Problem_solving_using_SEP/concerns/09-time-series-databases.md) | Cycle-indexed DAQ |

## Key Paths (BDPS)

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `internal/acquire/daq.go` | Ingest + REST API |
| `Deployment/docker/*/mqtt-broker/` | Broker config |
| `Deployment/docker/*/docker-compose*.yml` | Service wiring |

## Happy-Path Flow

1. DAQ client publishes step/cycle messages to tenant topic.
2. Backend consumer validates schema → upserts run + cycle rows.
3. DAQ Dashboard polls REST → shows live progress.
4. Alertwatcher reads same tables for CRE eval.

## Failure Scenarios

| Failure | Response |
| --- | --- |
| Broker down | Client buffers / retries; run may stall |
| Partial cycle ingest | Gap detection in analysis |
| Missing cycle 0 row | CNX-004 `invalid_t0` for time windows |
| Schema drift | Version gate in ingest handler |

# Problem 81: CNX-013 — CI/CD Deployment

**Parent:** [CellNostix Platform Overview](./83-cellnostix-platform-overview.md)

## Business Problem

**Build, integrate, promote, deploy, migrate, and rollback** CellNostix multi-container stacks (alpha, beta, prod, NAS) with repeatable evidence — without manual drift on VMs.

## Hard Requirements

- Azure Pipelines (`Deployment/azure_pipelines/`).
- Docker compose tiers: `Deployment/docker/{alpha,beta,prod}/`.
- NAS-specific compose (`.nas.yml`) and env files (`.env.*.nas`).
- Step 8 LF/CRLF guard on shell scripts and `.env.*.nas`.
- Submodule checkout for RGI engines and DAQ client in build agents.
- Test harness bundles (e.g. `agp006_v2/`) shipped with alpha test-data.

## Why One Pattern Is Not Enough

| If you only use… | What breaks |
| --- | --- |
| Manual docker cp to NAS | Untraceable deployments |
| One compose for all envs | Wrong volumes / secrets |
| CRLF shell scripts | Linux Step 8 / NAS exec failures |
| No migration step | Schema drift vs app code |

You need **pipeline stages**, **environment promotion**, **infrastructure as code**, **migration gates**, and **artifact immutability**.

## Architecture Overview

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Git["BDPS repo"]
    Pipe["Azure Pipelines"]
    Build["Build images"]
    Test["Unit + Step 8 syntax"]
    Push["ACR / registry"]
    Deploy["NAS / VM compose up"]
    Evidence["Logs + artifacts"]

    Git --> Pipe --> Build --> Test --> Push --> Deploy --> Evidence
```

## Pattern Mix

| Concern | Patterns | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Delivery | [CI/CD](../DevOps_Delivery_patterns/) | Automated promote |
| Environments | [Multi-environment](../DevOps_Delivery_patterns/) | alpha → beta → prod |
| Config | [Externalized config](../Cloud_infra_patterns/) | `.env.*.nas` per tier |
| Quality gate | [Shift-left testing](../DevOps_Delivery_patterns/) | `bash -n`, CRLF scan |
| Rollback | [Blue-Green / rollback](../DevOps_Delivery_patterns/) (conceptual) | Compose tag revert |

## Key Paths (BDPS)

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `Deployment/azure_pipelines/` | Pipeline definitions + step scripts |
| `Deployment/docker/alpha|beta|prod/` | Compose, nginx, mqtt, initial_script |
| `RGI_Repos/cellnostix-deployment-repo` | Deployment submodule |
| `Deployment/docker/SCHEMA_MATRIX_alpha_beta_prod.md` | Schema parity matrix |

## Happy-Path Flow

1. Merge to tracked branch → pipeline triggers.
2. Build backend/frontend images; run Go/JS tests where configured.
3. Step 8 validates deployment shell syntax + LF on NAS env files.
4. Push images → deploy to target tier → run DB migrations → smoke checks.

## Failure Scenarios

| Failure | Response |
| --- | --- |
| CRLF in `*.sh` | Step 8 fail — normalize to LF |
| Submodule not initialized | Build missing AEM/CellSage/ARULE |
| NAS ARULE dir permissions | Path B smokes fail — ops runbook |
| Schema drift beta vs prod | SCHEMA_MATRIX review |

## Why One Pattern Is Not Enough

    Publish --> Server
